chest-supported-row.name: Chest-Supported Row
setup: Chest flush against the pad
Pull elbows back and slightly down, not out to the sides
Pause a beat at full contraction
chest-supported-row.shouldFeel: A stretch across the outer back at the bottom, then the squeeze happening behind the armpit and shoulder blade — not in the biceps or the upper traps.

commonFaults.symptom: I feel it mostly in my biceps
commonFaults.fix: Lead with the elbow, not the hand — think 'elbow to back pocket' rather than 'pull the handle'.
Set the pad height so shoulders start slightly depressed; pull to lower ribs, not to the neck.

commonFaults.symptom: Right side does all the work (asymmetry)
commonFaults.fix: Switch to single-arm-lat-pulldown or seal-row for a block to force the left side to keep up.

flat-db-press.name: Flat Dumbbell Press
setup: Dumbbells start over the chest, not the face
Lower with control; stop the exercise if you feel pain or pinching
Press up and slightly in
flat-db-press.shouldFeel: A stretch across the chest at the bottom, pressure through the chest and front shoulder on the way up.

commonFaults.symptom: Pinching or sharp pain in the shoulder
commonFaults.fix: Stop the exercise and record the pain. Do not use technique cues to continue through it.
Slow the descent to 3 seconds and stop 2 inches short of full lockout on the way up to keep tension on the chest.

lat-pulldown-wide.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
setup: Grip just outside shoulder width
Lean back slightly, drive elbows down and back
Avoid yanking with body English
lat-pulldown-wide.shouldFeel: The stretch runs from the armpit down the side of the back, squeeze is under the shoulder blade at the bottom.

commonFaults.fix: Loosen your grip slightly and think about pulling with your elbows, not your hands.

commonFaults.symptom: Using momentum / leaning back too far
commonFaults.fix: Slow the negative to 2-3 seconds and keep the torso near vertical.

seated-db-shoulder-press.name: Seated Neutral-Grip DB Shoulder Press
setup: Palms facing each other (neutral grip) to keep the shoulder joint happy
Press up without flaring elbows past ear line
Stop the exercise if you feel pain or pinching overhead
seated-db-shoulder-press.shouldFeel: Effort across the top of the shoulder and side delt, not a pinch at the top of the movement.

commonFaults.symptom: Pinching at the top of the press
commonFaults.fix: Stop the exercise and record the pain. Do not use technique cues to continue through it.
Brace the core before each rep; drop the weight if bracing alone doesn't fix it.

cable-face-pull.name: Cable Face Pull
setup: Rope at upper-chest to face height
Pull hands apart toward your ears, thumbs back
Squeeze shoulder blades together at the end
cable-face-pull.shouldFeel: Burning across the back of the shoulders, not the traps.

commonFaults.fix: Drop the weight, pull to eye level not forehead, and lead with the backs of the hands.

db-lateral-raise.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
setup: Slight forward lean, dumbbells start at your sides
Lead with the elbows, raise to shoulder height
Slight forward tilt of the hand (pinky slightly higher) at the top
db-lateral-raise.shouldFeel: A burn on the outside/top of the shoulder cap, not the traps shrugging.

commonFaults.fix: Drop the weight 20% and consciously keep shoulders down; a lighter, cleaner set beats a heavier shrug.
Add a 1-second pause at the top of each rep, or try a band for constant tension.

ez-bar-curl.name: EZ-Bar Curl
setup: Elbows pinned to your sides through the whole rep
Curl without swinging the torso
Squeeze at the top
ez-bar-curl.shouldFeel: Tension building through the front of the upper arm start to finish.

commonFaults.fix: Drop the weight and pause 1 second at the bottom of each rep before the next.

cable-tricep-pushdown.name: Cable Tricep Pushdown
setup: Elbows pinned to your sides
Push down to full extension, control the return
cable-tricep-pushdown.shouldFeel: Burn along the back of the upper arm on the extension.

commonFaults.fix: Keep elbows glued to your ribs — if they drift forward, drop the weight.

seal-row.name: Seal Row (chest-supported bench row)
setup: Chest flat on an elevated bench, feet braced
Row to the bench, elbows back
No back involvement possible by design — good on a cranky low back
seal-row.shouldFeel: Same as chest-supported row: stretch at the bottom, squeeze under the shoulder blade.

commonFaults.fix: Lead with the elbow, think 'drag the bar up your shins in your mind's eye', not 'curl the bar'.

single-arm-lat-pulldown.name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
setup: One handle, seated or half-kneeling
Pull elbow down and back without rotating the torso
Control the stretch back up
single-arm-lat-pulldown.shouldFeel: Same stretch-to-squeeze feel as the two-arm version, but nowhere for the stronger side to compensate — good pick given the left/right lat gap.

commonFaults.fix: Brace against the seat or a half-kneeling position so the twist isn't available.

machine-shoulder-press.name: Machine Shoulder Press
setup: Seat height so handles start at shoulder level
Press up along the machine's fixed path
Machines fix the bar path, which is usually the easiest option on a cranky shoulder
machine-shoulder-press.shouldFeel: Effort across the front/top of the shoulder. Pain or pinching means stop the exercise.

commonFaults.fix: Stop the exercise and record the pain. Do not use technique cues to continue through it.

cable-rear-delt-fly.name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
setup: Cables crossed, slight forward lean
Sweep arms out and back, squeeze shoulder blades
cable-rear-delt-fly.shouldFeel: Burn across the back of the shoulder, not the traps.

commonFaults.fix: Drop the weight and slow down; this should feel light and controlled, not heavy.

hammer-curl.name: Hammer Curl
setup: Neutral grip (palms facing in)
Elbows pinned, curl without swinging
hammer-curl.shouldFeel: Tension through the outer bicep and forearm.

commonFaults.fix: Slow the tempo, drop the weight if you can't control it.

overhead-cable-tricep-extension.name: Overhead Cable Tricep Extension
setup: Face away from the stack, rope overhead
Elbows stay high and fixed, extend forearms forward
overhead-cable-tricep-extension.shouldFeel: A deep stretch through the triceps at the bottom, burn through extension.

commonFaults.fix: Pin elbows beside your ears, drop the weight until you can hold that position.

hip-90-90-mobility.name: 90/90 Hip Mobility
setup: Seated on the floor, front leg bent 90°, back leg bent 90° behind you
Lean forward over the front shin, hold, then rotate through to switch sides
Not a lifting movement — logged as a set but it's a warm-up/mobility block
hip-90-90-mobility.shouldFeel: A stretch through the outer hip and glute of the front leg, deeper the more restricted that side is.

commonFaults.symptom: No stretch felt at all on the tight side
commonFaults.fix: This matches a hip restriction that hasn't responded to stretching alone — worth flagging to a physio rather than pushing harder here.

leg-press.name: Leg Press
setup: Feet mid-platform, shoulder width
Lower until knees hit a comfortable depth, don't let the lower back round off the pad
Press through the whole foot
leg-press.shouldFeel: Quads doing the work, lower back staying flat against the pad the whole set.

commonFaults.symptom: Lower back rounds at the bottom
commonFaults.fix: Shallow the depth until the back stays flat — depth isn't worth it if the back peels off the pad.
Push knees out in line with your toes throughout.

hip-thrust.name: Hip Thrust
setup: Upper back on the bench, bar over hips
Drive through heels, squeeze glutes hard at the top
Chin tucked, ribs down — don't hyperextend the lower back at the top
hip-thrust.shouldFeel: A hard glute squeeze at the top, not a lower-back arch — a spine-friendlier way to load the hip hinge than a deadlift variant.

commonFaults.symptom: Lower back arches and takes over at the top
commonFaults.fix: Stop the rep just before full hip extension and tuck the chin/ribs down; squeeze glutes rather than pushing the hips further.

seated-leg-curl.name: Seated Leg Curl
setup: Pad snug above the heel
Curl through a full range, control the return
seated-leg-curl.shouldFeel: Burn through the back of the thigh, no lower back involvement.

commonFaults.fix: Drop the weight and tighten the lap belt/thigh pad if the machine has one.

standing-calf-raise.name: Standing Calf Raise
setup: Full stretch at the bottom, full extension at the top
Pause briefly at the top squeeze
standing-calf-raise.shouldFeel: Burn through the calf at full contraction.

commonFaults.fix: Slow down, use the full range, add a 1-second pause at the top.

cable-pallof-press.name: Cable Pallof Press
setup: Cable at chest height, stand side-on to the stack
Press the handle straight out from your chest and resist the pull rotating you
cable-pallof-press.shouldFeel: Bracing through the whole core to resist twisting — a good low-back-friendly core option.

commonFaults.fix: Drop the weight and widen your stance for a more stable base.

side-plank.name: Side Plank
setup: Elbow under shoulder, body in a straight line
Hips lifted, not sagging
side-plank.shouldFeel: A burn along the side of the waist, hips staying level throughout.

commonFaults.fix: Drop to knees-bent version until the straight-line hold is solid.

front-foot-elevated-split-squat.name: Front-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
setup: Front foot on a small plate/step, back foot behind on the floor
Drop straight down, torso upright
Unilateral — good for addressing side-to-side imbalance and works well within a hip restriction since range is self-limited
front-foot-elevated-split-squat.shouldFeel: Front thigh and glute doing the work, minimal back-leg involvement.

commonFaults.symptom: Back knee slams the floor / loses balance
commonFaults.fix: Shorten the stance slightly and go to a comfortable depth, not max depth.

walking-lunge.name: Walking Lunge
setup: Step forward, drop the back knee toward the floor
Push through the front heel to the next step
walking-lunge.shouldFeel: Front leg doing the work through the whole step.

commonFaults.symptom: Front knee drifts past the toes and feels unstable
commonFaults.fix: Take a slightly longer step.

hip-abduction-machine.name: Hip Abduction Machine
setup: Seated, pads on the outside of the knees
Push knees apart against the resistance, control the return
hip-abduction-machine.shouldFeel: Burn on the outside of the hip.

commonFaults.fix: Drop the weight, sit flat against the backrest.

dead-bug.name: Dead Bug
setup: On your back, knees at 90°, arms up
Lower opposite arm and leg while keeping the lower back flat on the floor
The low back staying pinned to the floor is the whole point of the exercise
dead-bug.shouldFeel: Core bracing to keep the lower back flat — if the back arches off the floor, the range was too big.

commonFaults.symptom: Lower back lifts off the floor
commonFaults.fix: Shorten the range of the reaching arm/leg until the back stays flat.

incline-db-press.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
setup: Bench at 30-45°
Control the lowering phase; stop the exercise if you feel pain or pinching
incline-db-press.shouldFeel: Stretch across the upper chest at the bottom, pressure through upper chest/front delt on the way up.

commonFaults.fix: Stop the exercise and record the pain. Do not use technique cues to continue through it.

barbell-bench-press.name: Barbell Bench Press
setup: Eyes under the bar and shoulder blades set back
Lower toward the lower chest with forearms vertical
Press up while keeping feet and upper back planted
barbell-bench-press.shouldFeel: Chest driving the bar away with stable shoulders and firm leg support.

machine-chest-press.name: Machine Chest Press
setup: Set the seat so handles line up with mid chest
Keep shoulder blades against the pad
Press with control; stop the exercise if you feel pain
machine-chest-press.shouldFeel: Even pressure across the chest with the machine supporting the movement path.

cable-chest-fly.name: Cable Chest Fly
setup: Handles just below shoulder height
Keep a soft fixed bend in the elbows
Bring upper arms together without shrugging
cable-chest-fly.shouldFeel: The chest shortening as the arms sweep inward, with tension maintained at the finish.

low-to-high-cable-fly.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
setup: Set cables low and step slightly forward
Sweep hands upward toward upper-chest height
Keep ribs down and shoulders away from ears
low-to-high-cable-fly.shouldFeel: Tension travelling upward across the upper chest rather than into the neck.

half-kneeling-landmine-press.name: Half-Kneeling Landmine Press
setup: Kneel opposite the pressing arm
Brace before pressing up and forward
Let the shoulder blade rotate naturally
half-kneeling-landmine-press.shouldFeel: Front shoulder and upper chest working without an overhead pinch.

cable-lateral-raise.name: Single-Arm Cable Lateral Raise
setup: Cable starts across the body
Lead outward with the elbow
Stop around shoulder height without shrugging
cable-lateral-raise.shouldFeel: Continuous tension on the outside of the shoulder.

reverse-pec-deck.name: Reverse Pec Deck
setup: Chest stays against the pad
Keep elbows level with the rear shoulders
Open the arms without arching the back
reverse-pec-deck.shouldFeel: A controlled burn behind the shoulders with only a light shoulder-blade squeeze.

prone-y-raise.name: Prone Y Raise
setup: Lie chest-down on a low incline bench
Raise light weights in a Y shape
Keep shoulders down as thumbs point upward
prone-y-raise.shouldFeel: A light contraction between and below the shoulder blades, away from the neck.

db-shrug.name: Dumbbell Shrug
setup: Stand tall with weights beside the thighs
Lift shoulders straight toward the ears
Pause briefly, then lower under control
db-shrug.shouldFeel: The upper traps shortening directly above the shoulder blades.

incline-db-curl.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
setup: Set bench to a moderate incline
Let arms hang behind the torso
Curl without moving the upper arms forward
incline-db-curl.shouldFeel: A long stretch and contraction through the outer portion of the biceps.

preacher-curl.name: Preacher Curl
setup: Place the whole upper arm on the pad
Start just short of a hard elbow lockout
Curl without lifting the elbows
preacher-curl.shouldFeel: Strong biceps tension with the upper arms fixed in place.

concentration-curl.name: Concentration Curl
setup: Brace the upper arm against the inner thigh
Curl slowly through a comfortable range
Pause at the top without rotating the torso
concentration-curl.shouldFeel: A focused contraction through one biceps at a time.

overhead-db-tricep-extension.name: Overhead Dumbbell Tricep Extension
setup: Hold one dumbbell securely overhead
Keep elbows aimed forward
Lower behind the head, then extend without flaring
overhead-db-tricep-extension.shouldFeel: A stretch and contraction along the long inner portion of the triceps.

ez-bar-skull-crusher.name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
setup: Lie flat with upper arms angled slightly back
Bend only at the elbows
Extend while keeping shoulders stable
ez-bar-skull-crusher.shouldFeel: The triceps lengthening behind the head and driving the forearms upward.

assisted-pull-up.name: Assisted Pull-Up
setup: Use enough assistance for controlled reps
Begin by drawing shoulders down
Pull elbows toward the ribs without swinging
assisted-pull-up.shouldFeel: The sides of the back pulling the upper arms down toward the torso.

straight-arm-pulldown.name: Straight-Arm Cable Pulldown
setup: Hinge slightly with arms nearly straight
Pull the bar toward the thighs
Keep ribs down and avoid turning it into a tricep press
straight-arm-pulldown.shouldFeel: The lats shortening from the armpits down the sides of the torso.

single-arm-db-row.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
setup: Support the free hand on a bench
Keep hips and shoulders square
Row toward the hip and pause without twisting
single-arm-db-row.shouldFeel: The shoulder blade moving toward the spine and the lat tightening near the armpit.

cable-crunch.name: Kneeling Cable Crunch
setup: Kneel with rope beside the head
Bring ribs toward the pelvis
Keep hips mostly fixed while the torso curls
cable-crunch.shouldFeel: The abdominal wall shortening without pulling mainly through the arms or hips.

hanging-knee-raise.name: Hanging Knee Raise
setup: Hang with shoulders active
Curl the pelvis as knees rise
Lower without swinging
hanging-knee-raise.shouldFeel: The lower abdominal area drawing the pelvis upward, with controlled hip flexor help.

cable-woodchop.name: Cable Woodchop
setup: Stand side-on with both hands on the handle
Rotate through the upper torso under control
Keep knees and feet stable
cable-woodchop.shouldFeel: The side abdominal wall controlling rotation across the torso.

ab-wheel-rollout.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
setup: Start kneeling with ribs tucked
Roll only as far as the lower back stays neutral
Pull back using the abs and lats
ab-wheel-rollout.shouldFeel: A strong full-abdominal brace without pressure in the lower back.

romanian-deadlift.name: Romanian Deadlift
setup: Begin tall with a soft knee bend
Push hips back while the bar stays close
Stop before the lower back rounds, then stand through the hips
romanian-deadlift.shouldFeel: A loaded stretch through the hamstrings and glutes with the torso held rigid.

commonFaults.fix: Stop the set and choose a supported leg curl or hip thrust instead.

romanian-deadlift.caution: Heavy hip hinge — loads the lower back.

lying-leg-curl.name: Lying Leg Curl
setup: Align knees with the machine pivot
Keep hips pressed into the pad
Curl smoothly and control the return
lying-leg-curl.shouldFeel: The back of the thighs shortening without the hips lifting.

leg-extension.name: Leg Extension
setup: Align knees with the machine pivot
Extend to a comfortable straight position
Lower slowly without letting the stack slam
leg-extension.shouldFeel: A concentrated contraction across the front of the thighs.

hack-squat.name: Hack Squat
setup: Set feet where knees track comfortably over toes
Keep back and hips against the pad
Descend only as far as position stays stable
hack-squat.shouldFeel: The quads carrying most of the load with support from the glutes.

cable-glute-kickback.name: Cable Glute Kickback
setup: Attach an ankle cuff and brace the torso
Drive the leg back from the hip
Stop before the lower back arches
cable-glute-kickback.shouldFeel: A focused squeeze through the working-side glute.

barbell-glute-bridge.name: Barbell Glute Bridge
setup: Lie with upper back and feet on the floor
Brace before driving hips upward
Finish with glutes rather than arching the spine
barbell-glute-bridge.shouldFeel: A strong glute contraction at the top with little lower-back movement.

cable-hip-abduction.name: Standing Cable Hip Abduction
setup: Attach an ankle cuff and stand tall
Move the leg slightly out and back
Keep the pelvis level and torso still
cable-hip-abduction.shouldFeel: A burn along the outer upper glute of the moving leg.

seated-calf-raise.name: Seated Calf Raise
setup: Place pads securely above the knees
Lower heels into a full stretch
Drive through the balls of the feet and pause
seated-calf-raise.shouldFeel: A deep burn lower in the calf, especially with the knees bent.

single-leg-calf-raise.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
setup: Use light hand support for balance
Drop the heel into a controlled stretch
Rise fully onto the ball of one foot
single-leg-calf-raise.shouldFeel: The calf working through a full range without bouncing.

conventional-deadlift.name: Deadlift (Conventional)
setup: Bar over mid-foot, shins close
Brace hard, pull the slack out of the bar
Push the floor away and stand tall; lower with control
conventional-deadlift.shouldFeel: Hamstrings and glutes driving the lift, upper back tight, grip working.

commonFaults.fix: Lighter load, pull slack out first, or switch to trap-bar.

conventional-deadlift.caution: Heavy spinal loading — keep a neutral back and stop the set if your lower back takes over.

trap-bar-deadlift.name: Trap-Bar Deadlift
setup: Stand centred in the bar, handles at your sides
Hips a little lower than a conventional pull, chest up
Drive through the whole foot to stand
trap-bar-deadlift.shouldFeel: A leg-driven pull — quads and glutes working, back staying neutral.
trap-bar-deadlift.caution: Heavy pull — easier on the lower back than a straight bar, but still brace.

sumo-deadlift.name: Sumo Deadlift
setup: Wide stance, toes out, hands inside the knees
Push knees out over the toes
Wedge hips to the bar and stand up
sumo-deadlift.shouldFeel: Inner thighs and glutes doing most of the work with a more upright torso.
sumo-deadlift.caution: Heavy spinal loading — keep a neutral back and stop the set if your lower back takes over.

db-romanian-deadlift.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
setup: Dumbbells in front of the thighs, soft knees
Hips back, dumbbells slide down the legs
Stop at a hamstring stretch, stand through the hips
db-romanian-deadlift.shouldFeel: A stretch down the back of the legs, back staying flat.
db-romanian-deadlift.caution: Hip hinge — loads the lower back; keep it lighter than you think.

rack-pull.name: Rack Pull
setup: Bar set just below or above the knee in the rack
Brace and squeeze the bar
Lock out hips and knees together
rack-pull.shouldFeel: Upper back, traps and glutes holding a heavy lockout.
rack-pull.caution: Heavy spinal loading — keep a neutral back and stop the set if your lower back takes over.

good-morning.name: Good Morning
setup: Bar on the upper back like a squat
Soft knees, push the hips back
Stop at a hamstring stretch, drive hips forward
good-morning.shouldFeel: Hamstring stretch with the torso staying rigid.
good-morning.caution: Heavy spinal loading — keep a neutral back and stop the set if your lower back takes over.

kettlebell-swing.name: Kettlebell Swing
setup: Hike the bell back between the legs
Snap the hips forward to float it to chest height
Let it fall and hinge again — arms just guide
kettlebell-swing.shouldFeel: A sharp glute squeeze at the top; arms relaxed.
kettlebell-swing.caution: Ballistic hinge — keep the back flat; stop if it's the lower back working.

back-extension.name: 45° Back Extension
setup: Pad just below the hip crease
Lower with a flat back
Squeeze glutes to come up level — don't hyperextend
back-extension.shouldFeel: Glutes and lower back working together, no pinch at the top.

glute-ham-raise.name: Glute-Ham Raise
setup: Feet locked, knees just behind the pad
Lower slowly with a straight hip line
Curl back up using the hamstrings
glute-ham-raise.shouldFeel: Hamstrings working hard at both ends of the knee.

nordic-curl.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
setup: Kneel with ankles anchored
Lower the body as slowly as possible, hips straight
Catch with hands and push back up
nordic-curl.shouldFeel: Hamstrings braking the fall — very demanding.

barbell-back-squat.name: Barbell Back Squat
setup: Bar on the upper back, brace before you unrack
Sit down between the hips, knees track over toes
Drive up keeping the chest and hips rising together
barbell-back-squat.shouldFeel: Quads and glutes; torso staying braced.
barbell-back-squat.caution: Heavy spinal loading — keep a neutral back and stop the set if your lower back takes over.

front-squat.name: Front Squat
setup: Bar on the front delts, elbows high
Sit straight down, torso upright
Drive up leading with the elbows
front-squat.shouldFeel: Mostly quads, upper back working to keep the bar on.
front-squat.caution: Loads the spine — more upright than a back squat.

goblet-squat.name: Goblet Squat
setup: Hold a dumbbell at the chest
Squat between the knees, elbows inside them
Stand tall and squeeze glutes
goblet-squat.shouldFeel: Quads working through a deep, upright squat.

smith-machine-squat.name: Smith Machine Squat
setup: Feet slightly in front of the bar
Sit down under control
Drive up through the mid-foot

pendulum-squat.name: Pendulum Squat
setup: Back flat on the pad, feet mid-platform
Sink deep under control
Push up without locking out hard
pendulum-squat.shouldFeel: Deep quad stretch with a supported back.

belt-squat.name: Belt Squat
setup: Belt around the hips, stand on the platform
Squat straight down
Drive up through the whole foot
belt-squat.shouldFeel: Legs working with no load on the spine.

bulgarian-split-squat.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
setup: Rear foot on a bench, front foot a stride ahead
Drop the back knee straight down
Drive through the front foot
bulgarian-split-squat.shouldFeel: Front-leg quad and glute; balance steady.

reverse-lunge.name: Reverse Lunge
setup: Step back into a lunge
Back knee just above the floor
Push through the front heel to return
reverse-lunge.shouldFeel: Front-leg glute and quad, knee comfortable.

step-up.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
setup: Whole foot on a knee-height box
Drive up through that foot, no push off the back leg
Lower slowly

sissy-squat.name: Sissy Squat
setup: Hold a support, rise onto the toes
Lean back as the knees travel forward
Stand back up through the quads
sissy-squat.shouldFeel: A big quad stretch above the knee.
sissy-squat.caution: Lots of knee flexion — skip if knees complain.

hip-adduction-machine.name: Hip Adduction Machine
setup: Pads on the inner knees
Squeeze the legs together
Control them back out

hip-thrust-machine.name: Hip Thrust Machine
setup: Upper back on the pad, belt over hips
Chin tucked, ribs down
Drive hips up and pause
hip-thrust-machine.shouldFeel: Glutes squeezing hard at the top.

leg-press-calf-raise.name: Calf Press on Leg Press
setup: Balls of the feet on the platform edge
Knees almost straight
Full stretch down, push up onto the toes

tibialis-raise.name: Tibialis Raise
setup: Back against a wall, heels forward
Lift the toes toward the shins
Lower slowly

pull-up.name: Pull-Up
setup: Overhand grip just outside the shoulders
Pull elbows down to the ribs
Lower to a full hang

chin-up.name: Chin-Up
setup: Underhand grip, shoulder width
Chest to the bar
Lower to a full hang
chin-up.shouldFeel: Lats and biceps sharing the work.

close-grip-lat-pulldown.name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
setup: V-handle, lean back slightly
Pull to the upper chest
Full stretch at the top

barbell-row.name: Barbell Row
setup: Hinge to about 45°, bar hanging
Row to the lower ribs
Lower under control without the torso bouncing
barbell-row.shouldFeel: Upper back and lats; lower back just holding position.
barbell-row.caution: Heavy spinal loading — keep a neutral back and stop the set if your lower back takes over.

pendlay-row.name: Pendlay Row
setup: Torso parallel to the floor, bar on the floor
Row explosively to the lower chest
Reset on the floor each rep
pendlay-row.shouldFeel: Upper back snapping the bar up.
pendlay-row.caution: Heavy spinal loading — keep a neutral back and stop the set if your lower back takes over.

t-bar-row.name: T-Bar Row
setup: Straddle the bar, hinge with a flat back
Row the handle to the chest
Stretch at the bottom
t-bar-row.caution: Bent-over — supported version is easier on the lower back.

seated-cable-row.name: Seated Cable Row
setup: Sit tall, slight knee bend
Row the handle to the stomach
Let the shoulders reach forward on the return

machine-row.name: Machine Row
setup: Chest on the pad
Drive elbows back
Full stretch forward
machine-row.shouldFeel: Mid back with the chest supported.

inverted-row.name: Inverted Row
setup: Hang under a bar, body straight
Pull chest to the bar
Lower to straight arms
inverted-row.shouldFeel: Upper back with a rigid body.

meadows-row.name: Meadows Row
setup: Landmine bar beside you, staggered stance
Overhand grip on the sleeve
Row the elbow up and back
meadows-row.shouldFeel: One side of the lats and upper back.

db-pullover.name: Dumbbell Pullover
setup: Lie across or along a bench, dumbbell over the chest
Lower behind the head with soft elbows
Pull back over the chest using the lats
db-pullover.caution: Big overhead stretch — keep it light if the shoulder's touchy.

incline-barbell-bench.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
setup: Bench at 30°, shoulder blades pinned
Lower to the upper chest
Press up and slightly back

decline-bench.name: Decline Bench Press
setup: Feet locked, slight decline
Lower to the lower chest
Press straight up

close-grip-bench.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
setup: Hands shoulder-width
Elbows tucked
Lower to the lower chest, press up

dips.name: Dips
setup: Lean slightly forward for chest
Lower until shoulders are just below elbows
Press back up
dips.shouldFeel: Chest and triceps; no pinch at the front of the shoulder.
dips.caution: Deep shoulder extension — stop short of discomfort at the front of the shoulder.

push-up.name: Push-Up
setup: Hands under the shoulders, body straight
Lower chest to the floor
Press up
push-up.shouldFeel: Chest and triceps with a rigid body.

pec-deck.name: Pec Deck
setup: Seat so handles are at chest height
Bring the arms together in a hug
Stretch back under control

smith-incline-press.name: Smith Machine Incline Press
setup: Bench at 30° under the bar
Lower to the upper chest
Press up
smith-incline-press.shouldFeel: Upper chest without balancing the bar.

overhead-press.name: Overhead Press (Standing)
setup: Bar on the front delts, glutes squeezed
Press up, head through at the top
Lower to the collarbones
overhead-press.caution: Overhead and standing — loads the shoulders and lower back.

arnold-press.name: Arnold Press
setup: Start with palms facing you at chin height
Rotate out as you press up
Reverse on the way down
arnold-press.caution: Rotation under load — skip if the shoulder's irritable.

machine-lateral-raise.name: Machine Lateral Raise
setup: Pads on the outside of the elbows
Raise to shoulder height
Lower slowly

upright-row-cable.name: Cable Upright Row (wide)
setup: Wide grip on a straight bar
Pull elbows up to shoulder height
Lower slowly
upright-row-cable.caution: Can pinch the shoulder — keep it wide and below shoulder height.

rear-delt-db-fly.name: Bent-Over Rear Delt Fly
setup: Hinge or lie chest-down on an incline
Sweep arms out wide
Lower slowly

barbell-curl.name: Barbell Curl
setup: Shoulder-width grip, elbows at the sides
Curl without swinging
Lower slowly

cable-curl.name: Cable Curl
setup: Straight bar or rope from a low pulley
Elbows fixed
Curl and squeeze

bayesian-cable-curl.name: Bayesian Cable Curl
setup: Face away from the pulley, arm behind you
Curl forward keeping the elbow back
Full stretch at the bottom

reverse-curl.name: Reverse Curl
setup: Overhand grip
Curl with elbows fixed
Lower slowly

wrist-curl.name: Wrist Curl
setup: Forearms on the thighs, palms up
Curl the wrist up
Lower to a stretch

db-tricep-kickback.name: Dumbbell Tricep Kickback
setup: Hinge, upper arm along the body
Straighten the elbow
Lower slowly

rope-pushdown.name: Rope Tricep Pushdown
setup: Rope at chest height, elbows at the sides
Push down and spread the rope
Control back up

bench-dip.name: Bench Dip
setup: Hands on a bench behind you
Lower until elbows are at 90°
Press back up
bench-dip.caution: Hard on the front of the shoulder — keep the range short.

plank.name: Plank
setup: Forearms under shoulders
Squeeze glutes, ribs down
Hold a straight line
plank.shouldFeel: Abs working to stop the hips sagging.

hanging-leg-raise.name: Hanging Leg Raise
setup: Hang with shoulders active
Raise straight legs to hip height or higher
Lower without swinging

russian-twist.name: Russian Twist
setup: Sit leaning back, feet down or up
Rotate the ribs side to side
Keep it slow
russian-twist.caution: Loaded twisting — skip if the lower back complains.

farmers-carry.name: Farmer's Carry
setup: Heavy dumbbells at the sides
Stand tall, ribs down
Walk with short, controlled steps
farmers-carry.shouldFeel: Grip, traps and core holding posture.

suitcase-carry.name: Suitcase Carry
setup: One heavy dumbbell at one side
Stay level — don't lean
Walk, then switch sides

treadmill-run.name: Treadmill Run
setup: Warm up for a few minutes
Settle into the target effort
Cool down
treadmill-run.shouldFeel: Steady breathing; pace you can hold.

incline-walk.name: Incline Treadmill Walk
setup: Warm up for a few minutes
Settle into the target effort
Cool down
incline-walk.shouldFeel: Glutes and calves on the incline; heart rate up.

stationary-bike.name: Stationary Bike
setup: Warm up for a few minutes
Settle into the target effort
Cool down
stationary-bike.shouldFeel: Legs spinning at a steady effort.

rowing-machine.name: Rowing Machine
setup: Warm up for a few minutes
Settle into the target effort
Cool down
rowing-machine.shouldFeel: Legs drive, then back, then arms.

stair-climber.name: Stair Climber
setup: Warm up for a few minutes
Settle into the target effort
Cool down

elliptical.name: Elliptical
setup: Warm up for a few minutes
Settle into the target effort
Cool down
